notes:

Completion source review (n_o): The locator page contains a unique reported test statistic, the z comparison of general-specific and one-specific-general correlations. Table I gives analysis-cell N=50 for each of these mutually exclusive randomized conditions. The N=56 joint-lead-in exception is outside this contrast.
